qt: to the Commission Bert-Jan Ruissen (ECR) Subject:

The Belgian federal regions are still intending to make a road tax disc compulsory as of 1 May 2027. According to media reports, the Belgian authorities are said to be in fact seeking to offset most of the costs borne by Belgian users by reforming the road tax system. In its reply of 31 August 20261 to my question of 11 July 20262 in which I asked whether this scheme amounted to unlawful discrimination, the Commission answered: ‘The level of the proposed new user charge and the new vehicle tax structure are not yet known’. For this reason, the Commission was not yet able to assess the matter. Time is beginning to run out. In particular, residents of border regions must be able to prepare in a timely manner. 1.
Can the Commission now give an opinion on the toll and road tax rates in the Belgian federal regions?
What implementation period does the Commission consider reasonable for the introduction of a road tax disc?
